beats.narration_text: Hi — I'm Sudhanva, with week five of the RL Environments project update: why QMIX collapsed, and how we fixed it.

props.segment: Week 5: Why QMIX Collapsed, and Why Sample over Greedy?
props.command: Find out why QMIX collapsed, fix it with settings only, and rescore every learner the way it acts in training.
output: QMIX team-value estimate: about 40 on the grid while the team scored 0
sync every 2,000 updates + half the learning rate: grid QMIX 0.13 to 8.44, VDN 6.05 to 8.55

beats.narration_text: QMIX collapsed after its estimate overshot, and two settings fixed that. Retuned, VDN and IQL match PPO in the free world. Only the grid still tells them apart.

props.text:
QMIX collapsed because
it can't learn the task
props.triggerWords: because, it can't learn the task
props.contextTitle: Why QMIX Collapsed, and Why Sample over Greedy?

shot.visual_intent: Writer types the arriving framing ('because it can't learn the task'), strikes 'because' → 'after' and 'it can't learn the task' → 'its estimate overshot'. Final: 'QMIX collapsed after / its estimate overshot' (7 words, lines ≤ 21 chars, fits 9:16). Two single-line triggers, comma-separated (component contract).

beats.narration_text: With the target network synced every five hundred updates, the QMIX team-value estimate overshoots: about forty on the grid while the team scores about zero. In one free-world seed it passes eight hundred thousand.

shot.new_visual_element: QMIX (default settings) team-value estimate per evaluation: grid seeds 0-1 on a linear axis with team food beside; free seed 2 on a log axis with its mixer weight |W1|
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: w5_film.json qmix_diag (results/fix-compare/qmix-diag/*/metrics.csv: pred_mean, mix_w1, team_value)

show.event: grid seeds 0-1 estimate curves draw; label '40 at 150k'
free seed 2 on a log axis: '865,716 at 500k'; mixer |W1| 1.54 → 301 noted

beats.narration_text: The fix: sync four times less often and halve the learning rate. Grid QMIX climbs from nearly zero to eight point four, VDN to eight point six, and the overshoot is gone.

shot.new_visual_element: Two settings cards (500 → 2,000 updates; 0.0005 → 0.00025); default vs tuned bars for grid QMIX and VDN (sampled, 3 seeds); largest estimate per run, default vs slower sync
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: w5_film.json scores (honest vs tuned grid-qmix, grid-vdn) and peaks (qmix-diag, screen, tuned)

show.event: largest estimate in a run: default 40 (grid) and up to 4,000,000 (free); with the slower sync 2.7–10.5

beats.narration_text: Scores are now sampled, as the ants act in training. Greedy play can deadlock, and it understated free-world IPPO: nine point six sampled, eight point five greedy.

shot.new_visual_element: Greedy vs sampled bars, free world, IPPO and MAPPO (5 seeds); caption on why greedy deadlocks
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: w5_film.json scores free-ippo/free-mappo greedy (metrics.csv final) vs sampled (eval_sampled.json); RESULTS.md §6.2

show.event: label: 'sampled: each ant draws its action as in training'
caption: 'greedy: two holders split, see nearly the same thing, split again'

beats.narration_text: In the free world, tuned VDN and IQL now score level with PPO, and IQL, blind to its teammates, pairs about as many pieces as IPPO. The grid still separates them: PPO above eleven and a half, VDN and QMIX about eight and a half.

shot.new_visual_element: Free-world bars at 1M (IPPO, tuned VDN, tuned IQL, MAPPO) with paired counts; grid bars (IPPO, MAPPO, tuned VDN, tuned QMIX) with holder agreement; captions for 10M and training-time agreement
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: w5_film.json scores (sampled), agreement_mean, train_agreement_grid_sampled, free-*-10M

show.event: free bars: IPPO 9.59, VDN 9.48, IQL 9.45, MAPPO 9.43 (sampled, 1M)
paired pieces: IQL 2.18 vs IPPO 2.29; IQL tagged 'can't see its teammates'
grid bars: IPPO 11.85, MAPPO 11.61, VDN 8.55, QMIX 8.44
holders pull the same way: PPO 93–94% vs VDN, QMIX 65–71%; IPPO during training 0.31 → 0.83 by 300k; free world at 10M: IPPO 11.49, MAPPO 11.41

beats.narration_text: Verdict: QMIX no longer collapses, and only the grid separates the learners. Next week: hiding one holder's home vector, still not run, and a sharper free-world test.

props.artifactTitle: Why QMIX Collapsed, and Why Sample over Greedy?
artifactLines: QMIX's estimate overshot with a 500-update sync; 2,000 updates and half the learning rate fixed it.
Grid, sampled: PPO 11.6–11.9 vs tuned VDN 8.55, QMIX 8.44; holders agree 93–94% vs 65–71%.
Free world, 1M: tuned VDN 9.48, IQL 9.45, level with IPPO 9.59, MAPPO 9.43. At 10M: 11.49, 11.41.
Next: hide one holder's home vector (still not run) · make the free world a sharper test.
